chunks.title: Build the executable MVP acceptance matrix
acceptance_criteria: Every required SPEC acceptance criterion maps to current executable tests, commands, and manual evidence
Any uncovered requirement becomes a scoped test/product gap in this sprint rather than an unsupported completion claim
Out-of-scope and optional engine-review work is clearly separated from required MVP gaps
The matrix is concise, reviewable, and links to stable repository artifacts

chunks.title: Prove the complete untimed saved-game journey
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test registers/logs in, creates and plays an untimed game, persists every accepted move, and reaches a terminal result
History and replay show the same labels, ordered moves, result, termination reason, and final FEN
Downloaded PGN reproduces the same moves, result, and final position
Account switching proves owner isolation throughout history, replay, and export

chunks.title: Prove the complete timed-game journey
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test creates a timed game and proves debit, increment, turn ownership, and refresh persistence
Timeout produces the correct win or cannot-win draw and freezes subsequent moves and clock changes
Saved history, replay, UI state, and PGN agree on time control, result, and termination reason
No test relies on wall-clock sleeps or nondeterministic timing

chunks.title: Harden browser clean-clone and recovery evidence
acceptance_criteria: Repository-owned browser smoke covers drag/drop, click/tap, keyboard movement, promotion, clocks, sound, terminal feedback, replay, and representative mobile/laptop layouts
A clean clone can install locked development tools, initialize SQLite idempotently, start with one documented command, and run the complete local gate
Malformed input, unauthorized access, stale session/database, and unavailable optional audio fail safely with documented recovery
The canonical check remains deterministic, local-only, and free of production accounts or hosted services

chunks.title: Reconcile documentation and package MVP release evidence
acceptance_criteria: Architecture, API, runbooks, README, debt ledger, acceptance matrix, and Ralph scorecard match the final required MVP
Generated documentation checks and all quality/security/dependency ratchets pass without weakened thresholds
A local release candidate packages the exact clean commit with notes, checksums, and manifest and excludes runtime user data
The full ./scripts/check.sh gate passes from the final clean state and optional engine review remains explicitly deferred
